established: Oracle-free greedy iterative decompression (brotli->gzip, MAX_DEPTH=5, no SHA256 oracle) produces byte-identical output to ground truth across all five cache lifecycle stages through local nginx 1.24.0 proxy_cache: fresh HIT 240/240, SWR stale 240/240, SIE stale 240/240, 304 substrate 240/240 correct (nginx converts 304 to 200 MISS), re-fetch 240/240. Overall 960/960 across stages with bodies (EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543, audit PASS).

Oracle-free greedy iterative decompression produces byte-identical output to ground truth for 100% of cached responses through local nginx proxy_cache: 330/330 cached-path observations (240/240 primary 48x5 HIT, 45/45 depth 3-5, 30/30 >100KB, 15/15 identity), 6/6 stability groups, 0 ambiguous tie-breaks, 1078/1078 total (EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706, audit PASS).

Oracle-free greedy iterative decompression produces byte-identical output to ground truth on Cloudflare free-tier DYNAMIC responses: 240/240 primary matrix (EXP-RUNTIME-35544804817, audit REVISE, ceiling bounded).

Cache freshness lifecycle does not break oracle-free decompression on local nginx: SWR stale serving (120 HIT + 120 STALE = 240), SIE stale serving (240 STALE), 304 revalidation path, and re-fetch (240 MISS) all byte-identical. The parent's 'cache freshness edge cases' unknown is closed within local-nginx scope (EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543).

Brotli (magic 0xCEB2CF81) and gzip (magic 0x1F8B) have distinct format signatures making greedy try-brotli-then-gzip order unambiguous: zero ambiguous tie-breaks across 2047+ observations (EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543 + EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706).

CDN edge transformation (not caching layer) broke fixed-order framing: fixed-order baseline 2041/2041 on local nginx vs 60/240 on Cloudflare edge (parent EXP-RUNTIME-35538865067, 60/240 failure). Confirms byte-preserving proxy vs CDN edge distinction.
Local nginx proxy_cache does not re-encode bytes: 48/48 DYNAMIC-vs-HIT byte-identical (EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706), fixed-order 2041/2041 on local nginx (EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543).

recommended_action: Design and execute EXP-RUNTIME on a production Cloudflare paid-tier zone or alternative CDN (Fastly/Akamai/CloudFront) that produces real cache HIT responses. The frozen design should: (1) use the same oracle-free greedy decode algorithm; (2) include N=5 per HIT cell with two-phase populate+test; (3) persist all raw observations including stability rows; (4) re-run oracle-guided and fixed-order baselines on same wire bytes; (5) record CDN edge identity and tier; (6) test both fresh HIT and stale serving (SWR/SIE) on the production CDN. If HIT serving is achieved and byte-identical DYNAMIC-vs-HIT wire bytes are confirmed, C-MEAS-VALID can advance to VALIDATED. If CDN alters cached bytes, the specific transformation will be documented. If no production CDN is available, the local-nginx-validated finding should be explicitly annotated as infrastructure-bounded in the Codex.
